{{Quote|You made it! Several Jedi have already gone ahead into the Star Forge. We have to strike while we still have the element of surprise!|The Jedi upon [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] landing aboard the [[Star Forge]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
In [[3956 BBY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Jedi''' was present aboard the [[Star Forge]]. She served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] against the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]], she and several other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were sent aboard the Star Forge as a strike team.

==Biography==
===Prelude to the Battle===
{{Quote|We'll deal with these Sith – you get into the Star Forge and find Bastila! Hurry!|The Jedi to Revan following an ambush|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
During the [[Old Sith Wars]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as a [[Jedi]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], whom she served, had been struggling against the forces of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], now under the command of [[Darth Malak]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the beginning of the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="3years">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' places the beginning of the [[Jedi Civil War]] at the [[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|Battle of Foerost]] in [[3959 BBY]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in [[3956 BBY]], three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the beginning of the war.</ref> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who's memory had been [[Amnesia/Legends|erased]], was retrained by the Jedi. Alongside [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bastila Shan]], they discovered the location of the [[Star Forge]], an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] and [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and the secret of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] overwhelming infrastructure. Bastila had been captured by Malak and seduced by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] during their mission. Upon arriving in the [[Lehon system|system]] where the Star Forge was located, Revan contacted the Republic, but a [[disruptor field]] based on the planet of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] incapacitated their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]''. The crew of the ''Hawk'' destroyed the shield and confronted Shan, who fled to the station from the surface.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===The Battle of Rakata Prime===
{{Quote|Come on before they— Damn! So much for catching them unprepared.|The Jedi to Revan during the ambush|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Sf-battle.jpg|thumb|left|325px|The Battle of Rakata Prime]]
With the disruptor field now destroyed, a massive [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic assault fleet]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Forn Dodonna]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vandar Tokare]], [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]] into the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The fallen Bastila Shan, on the station, began using her renowned [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] against the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Now losing the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|battle]] and unable to attack, Tokare ordered several Jedi, including the Revan and the Human female, to board the station and defeat Bastila. Upon boarding, most of the Jedi went forward into the station. The human female and three other Jedi stayed behind in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], waiting to assist Revan and the ''Ebon Hawk''{{'s}} crew with the infiltration. Although they had hoped for the element of surprise, shortly after Revan's arrival a group of Sith ambushed the Jedi. Although the Jedi told Revan to go ahead, the trap had already sprung, and Revan was forced into the battle.<ref name="KOTOR" />

After defeating the Sith, Revan and his companions ran into the Star Forge to find Shan, while the four Jedi waited at the hangar to defend the ship against any further assaults. Revan found and defeated both Shan and Malak, bringing Shan back to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]. Now using her battle meditation to assist the Republic, Shan allowed the assault fleet to find a gap in the enemy lines, and the battle was won by the Republic.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi was a Human female. She had fair skin, dark [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and long black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] tied into a ponytail.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi wore typical light beige [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]], with a white tunic, white pants, and dark brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. She carried a one single-bladed violet [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which she used in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
